title: Main spell instruction (choose two friendly units at different locations; if at least one has [Temporary], swap their locations) is entirely missing
expected: Card def /root/src/tcg/tcg-engines/packages/riftbound-cards/src/cards/unl/smoke-and-mirrors.ts:4-16 has no explicit `abilities` field; abilities are derived from rulesText via parseAbilities. Running parseAbilities on the card's rulesText yields exactly [{keyword Hidden}, {type:spell, timing:action, effect:{type:draw, amount:1}}] — the "Choose a unit you control and another unit you control at a different location. If at least one of them has [Temporary], move each to the other's location." clause is silently dropped at the parser layer, so no targeting/choice or swap effect exists for the engine to execute. Matches observed behavior (only draw 1 resolves).
observed: No pendingChoice / no target params on playSpell; chain item effect was only {"amount":1,"type":"draw"}; after resolution Keeper of Masks stayed in base and Sprite stayed at battlefield-player-1-bf-ogn-276-298; only the draw happened. Built card abilities (getAllCards) confirm: [keyword Hidden, spell{draw 1}] — the choose/move clause is dropped at card/parser level
